description.fun: Azelf, the Being of Willpower, is said to have given people the determination to act. It sleeps at the bottom of Lake Valor to keep the world in balance, and it's believed that harming it would leave people frozen, unable to decide anything. Some even dread it for turning its foes into puppets. Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf are thought to have hatched from the same egg.
description.guide: Azelf is a Psychic-type Legendary Pokémon and one of Sinnoh's three lake guardians, with Uxie and Mesprit. Known as the Being of Willpower, it sleeps in Lake Valor, and it is said to have given people the determination to act.
description.tagline: The lake guardian of willpower, keeping the world in balance.
